The '''Grandine system''' was a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] event known as the [[Grandine Swoop Loop]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Grandine [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
